title: Rouding decimal inside of the mustache
body:
I was trying to round some decimal inside of the template. Like,

```coffee
# application.coffee
# ...
search.addWidget instantsearch.widgets.hits(
  container: '#hits'
  templates:
    empty: 'No results'
    item: "{{{Math.round(A)}}}") # A is a value of something from Algolia
# ...
```
I checked the documentation, but I didn't find anything.
